svg.aria-label: Markdown lectures: KaTeX math, Shiki highlighting, ECharts, Mermaid and WaveDrom, numbered figures and concepts.; Course maps: Category-zoned home atlas, site-wide ELK prerequisite canvas, and per-group lecture maps.; Reading progress: Not started, in progress, done; stored in the browser or synced per reader via lecture-api.; AI companion: Chat sidebar and quick actions; model calls engine tools over HTTP or external MCP endpoints.; Access tiers: Groups set public, signed-in or named user groups; restricted content stays out of public files.; Themes, languages: Reader and datasheet themes, light/dark modes, replaceable slots; Chinese and English UI.
